about: The command line's parity manifest (tools/check_cli_parity.mjs, docs/CLI.md "Adding an option"): every field of the engine's run request (ck-core job.rs parse) with the corridorkey flags that set it, or not-on-cli with the reason; and every other render/verify flag (cli-only) with what it is for.

id.not-on-cli: the CLI names each run itself

num_frames.not-on-cli: a sample of a movie (the original's --num_frames); the app doesn't send it either; on the command line --frames picks the frames

start_mode.not-on-cli: where that sample starts (the original's --start_mode); the app doesn't send it either; --frames picks the frames

seed.not-on-cli: random_middle's seed (the original's --seed); the app doesn't send it either; --frames picks the frames

cli-only.--job: reads a run request from a file (the fields above); flags win over it
cli-only.--overwrite: the CLI's own handling of frames already at the output's names
cli-only.--skip-existing: the CLI's own handling of frames already at the output's names
cli-only.--progress-format: the CLI's progress lines for a farm
cli-only.--report: the CLI's JSON report of the run
cli-only.--models: the engine's model set (the app: Engine page; the engine's start, not a run)
cli-only.--ort: ONNX Runtime's library (the app: Engine page; the engine's start, not a run)
cli-only.--device: the engine's provider (the engine's start, not a run)
cli-only.--gpu: which card (the engine's start, not a run)
cli-only.--threads: CPU threads per network (the engine's start, not a run)
